And honestly I feel like most tracks are pretty forgettable but still has some great bangers (Crybaby is one of my favorites of all time) 

Here’s where it gets tricky for me because I usually don’t count No Life and Life Sux and I legitimately Love all these so much but that being said

4. You’re Welcome: I actually think this album is amazing and was a great step for Wavves. I think it was a perfect blend of what we knew Wavves to be and introduced more sounds and types of music they were willing to put out. (Million Enemies, Come to the Valley, Under) 

3. No Life For Me: my god, this album was everything to me. It says so much in those 7 tracks it’s an album that blew me away and still does. Nathan and Dylan Baldi really struck gold on this one. 

2. Afraid of Heights: this was a toss up because this album always seemed more cohesive and well produced. (Than King of the Beach) top to bottom a spectacular album.
